tag_scale_desc: Scale tag text, icons an' paddin' on web an' native posters.
tag_gap_desc: Adjust spacin' between tags in stacks, rows, bands an' captions.
language_priority_help: Pick yer own tongue order fer audio an' subtitles on web an' native posters. An empty personal list keeps detection order. Regional flags still follow th' ship server’s merge settin'.
language_priority_search: Scout tongues by name or ISO code
language_priority_save_failed: Arr, could not stash th' tongue policy. Yer previous choice has been restored.
awards_tags_description: Charts, Certified Fresh an' Oscar/Emmy wins, freshened on th' ship server.
admin_tags_peruser_hint: Each sailor has a personal copy. Existin' sailors keep theirs until ye overwrite it.
admin_tags_intro: Alterations stash automatically. These be th' standards fresh sailors start wi' an' th' settin's all hands shares; existin' sailors keep theirs, an' any hand can alter their own look in their Media Tags settin's.
admin_tags_load_failed: Th' Media Tags settin's could not be loaded from th' ship server.
admin_tags_leave_confirm: These Media Tags alterations could not be stashed: {fields}. Go back to th' Media Tags page to retry? They stay waitin' there either way.
admin_tags_preview_note: Locked looks come first, then ship server-wide booty looks, then th' first matchin' rule, then episode an' list-row looks, then th' standard.
admin_tags_preview_existing: Existin' sailors keep their settin's until they reset them or ye put to use th' standards to all sailors
admin_tags_native_off: off. Apps such as Android TV hoist untagged posters.
admin_tags_native_on: on. Apps such as Android TV get these tags drawn into th' poster, as {look}.
admin_tags_native_on_colours: on, wi' yer tag paints. Apps such as Android TV get these tags drawn into th' poster, as {look}.
admin_tags_overview_groups_desc: Open a crew to alter its settin's.
admin_tags_overview_cache_off: Off: browsers fetch tag data page by page an' keep their own copy.
admin_tags_overview_cache_unknown: Th' chest state could not be read. Inspect th' ship server log.
admin_tags_overview_native_desc: Draws tags into poster images fer apps that can't hoist th' web overlays, such as Android TV.
admin_tags_rebuild_title: Rebuild th' ship server tag chest?
admin_tags_rebuild_confirm: This re-scans th' whole library in th' background an' may take a few minutes. Tags keep servin' from th' existin' chest until th' rebuild be done.
admin_tags_rebuild_started: Rebuildin' th' tag chest in th' background.
admin_tags_rebuild_running: A tag chest rebuild be already in progress.
admin_tags_rebuild_cache_off: Turn on th' ship server tag chest first.
admin_tags_rebuild_failed: Th' rebuild could not start. Inspect th' ship server log.
admin_tags_rebuild_unsaved: Not rebuilt: alterations on this page be not stashed yet. Retry th' stash, or pick Keep mine or Take theirs, then rebuild again.
admin_tags_layout_look_desc: Where th' tags sit on a poster, an' how long their labels be.
admin_tags_layout_groups_desc: Higher crews win when space be short an' stack nearest th' edge. Th' limit be how many chips a crew hoists.
admin_tags_layout_groups_for: Berths fer th' {layout} layout. Pick another layout above to set its berths.
admin_tags_layout_shapes_desc: Episode thumbnails an' list rows have less room than a poster: give them their own look or keep th' standard one. Native Poster Tags draw on posters only an' ignore these.
admin_tags_shape_recommended_landscape: Recommended: bands, compact (status an' age on top, quality an' ratin' below)
admin_tags_shape_recommended_list: Recommended: corners, compact (quality, status an' ratin', up to 2 each)
admin_tags_hide_on_hover_desc: Tags fade out while th' pointer be over a card. Sailors can alter this.
admin_tags_disable_on_search: No tags on th' scout page
admin_tags_disable_on_search_desc: Keeps quality, tongue, tale type an' ratin' tags off scout results. Recommended wi' th' Gelato plugin.
admin_tags_apply_all: Put to use standards to all sailors
admin_tags_apply_all_desc: Copies th' stashed Jellyfin Enhanced standards into every sailor's settin's, replacin' what they chose themselves.
admin_tags_apply_all_confirm: Every sailor's Jellyfin Enhanced settin's (all o' them, not only Media Tags) be replaced wi' th' stashed standards. This can't be undone; sailors would have to set their own preferences again.
admin_tags_apply_all_done: Th' standards now put to use to every sailor. They take effect after sailors reload.
admin_tags_apply_all_failed: Th' standards could not be put to use. Inspect th' ship server log.
admin_tags_quality_desc: Resolution, source, HDR, format an' sound badges. Pick th' categories an' th' order they stack in.
admin_tags_quality_low_source_desc: Hoists CAM, TS, TC an' SCR sources as well.
admin_tags_quality_aggregation_desc: Which episodes a series or season card describes, matey.
admin_tags_quality_audio_language: Preferred audio tongue fer sound tags
admin_tags_quality_audio_language_desc: Th' sound tag describes th' best track in this tongue, not th' best track in th' file. Titles without it fall back to their best track. Sailors can override this.
admin_tags_quality_audio_from_user: Use each sailor's Jellyfin audio tongue
admin_tags_quality_audio_from_user_desc: Judge sound tags by each sailor's own preferred audio tongue. Sailors without one keep th' tongue above.
admin_tags_genre_desc: Themed icons fer th' tale types o' a title, wi' th' names on hover.
admin_tags_genre_enabled: Tale Type tags fer fresh sailors
admin_tags_genre_summary: Themed icons, names on hover, arr
admin_tags_language_desc: Audio an' subtitle tongues as flags or codes, wi' an optional Dual/Multi badge. Sailors can override what to hoist.
admin_tags_language_show_subtitles_desc: Subtitle tongues follow th' audio ones an' carry a small CC mark. Both count towards th' crew's limit. Needs th' ship server tag chest rebuilt once after updatin'.
admin_tags_language_style_desc: Both hoist th' full tongue name on hover.
admin_tags_language_count_badge_desc: Two audio tongues hoist "Dual", three or more "Multi", instead o' th' audio flags or ahead o' them.
admin_tags_language_priority_desc: Comma-separated names or codes. A title wi' audio in one o' these always hoists that flag among th' ones shown. Leave blank to hoist th' first tongues found.
admin_tags_language_priority_strict_desc: Stow flags fer every tongue not listed. A title wi' none o' them hoists no flags.
admin_tags_language_merge_regions_desc: One flag per tongue, as Jellyfin's own audio tongue filter does: English an' English (United Kingdom) share a flag.
admin_tags_rating_desc: Scores on posters: where they hoist, which sources an' in what order. Sailors can override these.
admin_tags_rating_on_episodes_desc: Off keeps reputations off every episode card, Next Up an' Continue Watchin' included.
admin_tags_rating_on_continue: Hoist in th' Continue Watchin' row
admin_tags_rating_on_next_up: Hoist in th' Next Up row
admin_tags_rating_min_desc: Stow scores below this, on a scale o' ten.
admin_tags_rating_in_player: Hoist th' ratin' in th' video player
admin_tags_rating_in_player_desc: TMDB an' Rotten Tomatoes reputations afore th' "Ends at" time.
admin_tags_mdblist_desc: Source scores (IMDb, Metacritic, Letterboxd…) come from MDBList when it be set up. Its key, quota an' fetch task live wi' MDBList Reputations.
admin_tags_mdblist_fetch_off: Th' fetch task be off, so only live lookups fill th' scores.
admin_tags_age_rating_desc: Th' age ratin' (PG-13, TV-MA, FSK 12…) as a badge coloured by its board. Episodes an' seasons use their series' ratin'.
admin_tags_age_rating_enabled: Age ratin' tags fer fresh sailors
admin_tags_status_summary: {n} o' {total} badge families · just tacked on {days} days
admin_tags_status_summary_one: {n} o' {total} badge families · just tacked on {days} day
admin_tags_people_desc: Age an' birthplace on cast members' cards on detail pages.
admin_tags_people_summary: Age an' birthplace on cast cards
admin_tags_rules_desc: Th' first enabled rule that matches a card gives it its layout an' density. Fresh sailors (an' "Put to use standards to all sailors") start wi' these; sailors mend their own copy.
admin_tags_rules_none: No rules. Fresh sailors start wi' th' standard look.
admin_tags_rules_edit_keeps: This rule also sets its own crew berths or episode an' list-row looks. Savin' keeps them; alter them as JSON.
admin_tags_rules_json_desc: Fer what th' form does not set: per-rule crew berths an' episode or list-row looks. Each rule: when (1-5 conditions, all must hold; field library, type, tale type or ageRatin'), layout an' density. At most 50 rules.
admin_tags_rules_json_stale: Th' stashed rules altered while ye were editin'. Stash JSON replaces them wi' this text; Revert loads th' stashed rules.
admin_tags_rules_json_array: Expected a JSON array o' rules.
admin_tags_rules_json_density: Rule {n}: density must be full or compact, matey.
admin_tags_rules_json_condition: Rule {n}: condition {m} needs a known field an' a value.
admin_tags_rules_json_library: Rule {n}: a library condition needs a library id, matey.
admin_tags_locks_desc: Locks keep one title's look whatever th' rules say. They belong to each sailor, who sets them from an booty's menu an' manages them in their Media Tags settin's, so there be none to set here.
admin_tags_item_looks_desc: Looks one title gets fer every sailor, set wi' Fer all hands in th' booty's Media Tags editor (its ⋮ menu). A sailor's own locked look wins; rules never alter these.
admin_tags_item_looks_none: No ship server-wide booty looks yet.
admin_tags_item_looks_edit_named: Mend th' ship server-wide look o' {name}
admin_tags_item_looks_remove_named: Cast off th' ship server-wide look o' {name}
admin_tags_colours_desc: Paints fer quality, age ratin', ratin', tale type, status, tongue, awards, logo an' custom tags.
admin_tags_colours_enabled_desc: Off hoists th' original paints (custom CSS keeps workin'). Yer edits be kept.
admin_tags_colours_target_desc: Web recolours th' overlays an' wins over custom CSS paints. Native posters draws th' paints into th' posters o' apps such as Android TV (needs Native Poster Tags; status tags be not drawn there).
admin_tags_colours_allow_preset: Let sailors pick their own preset
admin_tags_colours_allow_preset_desc: Hoists a paint preset choice in each sailor's Media Tags settin's. Yer crew an' label paints stay on top o' their preset.
admin_tags_colours_reset_confirm: Every crew an' label paint goes back to th' Standard preset.
admin_tags_colours_genre_note: Each tale type has its own paints (spellings an' translations o' a tale type share them); Text paints th' icon. Genres without an icon o' their own use Other.
tag_styles_note_poster: Poster: each tag takes its background from th' artwork it sits on (white or black text, whichever reads better). Paints set here stay on top; Standard falls back to th' artwork. Th' peek hoists a red poster.
tag_styles_note_status: Status badges use th' same paints on web cards an' native posters.
tag_styles_note_language: Tongue chips use Background, Border an' Text, includin' per-tongue paints an' Dual/Multi. Flag images keep only their border ring; partial flags keep their dashed outline.
tag_styles_note_logos: Paints th' pill behind a logo, or th' name chip a logo without an image hoists (Text paints th' name).
tag_styles_note_custom: One target per label o' th' Custom tag rules above (labels shared by several rules share their paints). Th' icon takes th' text paint.
tag_styles_reset_to_group: Back to th' crew or preset paint
tag_styles_opacity_note: Pick a paint to set its opacity
tag_styles_contrast_lowest: Lowest in th' crew ({name}): text over background, on a dark poster
tag_styles_contrast_text: Text over background, on a dark poster, arr
tag_styles_contrast_artwork: Worst case over any artwork: Poster takes each tag's paints from th' poster it sits on, so this be th' lowest contrast th' poster paints can give
tag_styles_contrast_set_here: {hint}. Its paints be all set here; tags without their own take them from th' poster they sit on
tag_styles_load_failed: Arr, could not load th' tag list.
admin_tags_badges_off: Status tags be off fer fresh sailors, so none o' these hoist.
admin_tags_badges_trending_desc: Rank in TMDB's daily trendin' list (needs th' TMDB API key), or Seerr's weekly list without one. Off also stops th' ship server fetchin' th' list.
admin_tags_badges_windows_desc: These put to use to all hands.
admin_tags_badges_just_added_days_desc: An booty counts as just tacked on (an' a series or season hoists Fresh Episode) fer this many days after it reached th' library.
admin_tags_badges_new_release_days_desc: A flick or series counts as fresh fer this many days after its premiere.
admin_tags_badges_tmdb_desc: Daily popular ranks, next air dates an' season an' series finales use th' TMDB API key. Without it, trendin' can use Seerr's weekly list.
admin_tags_badges_leaving_desc: Booty in Maintainerr's collections or th' leavin' collections (set th' source under Leavin' soon).
admin_tags_badges_direct_play_desc: Each browser checks th' flicks an' episodes on screen against its own playback support (web only; native posters have no client profile). Booty Jellyfin would probe to answer, .strm booty an' media never probed, be skipped.
admin_tags_leaving_desc: Where th' Leavin' soon badge comes from: Maintainerr's collections (wi' th' day each booty goes), or existin' Jellyfin collections by name (no date).
admin_tags_leaving_url_desc: Th' address this ship server reaches Maintainerr at. Empty uses only th' collection names.
admin_tags_leaving_key_desc: Optional. Kept on th' ship server like th' other keys an' never sent to sailors.
admin_tags_leaving_collections_desc: Existin' collection names, one per line, whose booty count as leavin' soon (fer setups without th' API). Up to 20.
admin_tags_leaving_refresh_desc: How often th' ship server reads th' source again (1–168 hours). A foundered request be retried sooner.
admin_tags_leaving_note: Cards never ask Maintainerr: th' ship server reads it on this schedule an' keeps th' answer in th' tag chest.
admin_tags_leaving_detail: {items} booty leavin' ({dated} wi' a date) · last read {last} · next {next}
admin_tags_leaving_detail_one: {items} booty leavin' ({dated} wi' a date) · last read {last} · next {next}
admin_tags_leaving_refresh_unsaved: Not freshened: alterations on this page be not stashed yet. Retry th' stash, or pick Keep mine or Take theirs, then freshen again.
admin_tags_server_cache_desc: Tag data fer every booty, worked out on th' ship server. Browsers download it once, in pages, keep a copy an' then fetch only what altered.
admin_tags_server_cache_on_desc: Tags load at once, without per-page requests. Off uses th' older per-page mode an' releases th' chest; turnin' it on again restores th' last copy an' catches up in th' background.
admin_tags_server_exclude: Exclude libraries from th' tag chest
admin_tags_server_exclude_desc: Fer very large libraries that use a lot o' memory to scan. Takes effect on th' next rebuild.
admin_tags_server_libraries_failed: Arr, could not load th' library list. Th' current selection be kept.
admin_tags_server_fallback: Keep a tag chest in each browser
admin_tags_server_fallback_desc: Without th' ship server chest, browsers keep tag data in local storage fer faster repeat visits.
admin_tags_server_ttl_desc: How long browsers keep tag data fetched without th' ship server chest, an' People Tags facts (1-365). Th' ship server chest keeps itself current.
admin_tags_server_rebuild_desc: Rebuild re-computes every booty's tags. Use it after an update alterations how tags be worked out, or when asked to. Large libraries take a few minutes.
admin_tags_server_clear_desc: Clearin' makes every browser drop its tag data on its next load, which may be slow once.
admin_tags_server_clear_confirm: Every browser clears its quality an' tale type tag data on its next page load.
admin_tags_server_clear_done: Swab signal sent. Browsers clear their chests on their next load.
admin_tags_server_clear_failed: Th' clear signal could not be stashed. Inspect th' ship server log.
admin_tags_server_native_desc: Each sailor's tags drawn into poster images, fer apps that can't hoist th' web overlays.
admin_tags_server_native_on_desc: Uses each sailor's own tag choices, corners an' order. Sailors can turn it off wi' Hoist Tags in Native Clients.
admin_tags_server_native_clients_desc: Apps that already hoist these tags themselves, such as a wrapper around th' web UI, by their name under Dashboard › Devices; one per line or comma separated. Jellyfin Web, Media Player, Desktop, WebOS an' Android be always excluded.
admin_tags_server_native_note_1: Web-based apps already hoist th' overlays an' keep th' original posters.
admin_tags_server_native_note_2: Each poster be drawn th' first time it be viewed, which uses some ship server CPU, then cached.
admin_tags_server_native_note_3: Apps may need to reopen th' library or restart to hoist alterations.
admin_tags_server_native_note_4: Original artwork files be never modified.
admin_tags_awardsTagsImdbList: IMDb list (numeric id or owner/slug) arr
admin_tags_awardsTagsLetterboxdList: Letterboxd list (numeric id or owner/slug) arr
admin_tags_logoTagsRegion: Logo region (two letters; blank follows th' ship server)
admin_tags_awards_desc: Ribbons from reputations an' award sources. MDBList credentials stay on th' main settin's page. Failed lookups retry after an hour.
admin_tags_logos_desc: Pick flick an' series logos, their region an' maximum count. Images share a fixed 64 MiB chest budget.
admin_tags_custom_desc: Match existin' tags or collections to labels an' icons. Up to 20 rules; labels up to 24 characters. Collections require th' ship server chest.
quality_display_help: All hoists distinct values in rank order. Sound follows yer audio tongue. Hoist up to limits th' whole Quality crew.
admin_status_tags_scenes_description: Hoist a flick’s post-credits or mid-credits marker from TMDB keywords. Requires a TMDB key; freshened daily.
toast_quality_tags_follow_server: Quality tag settin's follow th' ship server again
panel_settings_ui_quality_tags_follow_se: Edition, low-quality sources, th' category order an' th' series policy follow th' cap'n again, includin' their later alterations.
tag_portable_desc: Stash yer Media Tags settin's as a file, or bring in settin's shipped out here or on another ship server. Ye see what alterations afore anything be put to use.
tag_portable_export_desc: Yer layout, crews, berths, sizes, status badges, tongue priority an' paint preset. Rules an' locked booty stay here: they name this ship server's libraries an' titles.
tag_portable_export_failed: Arr, could not read th' settin's. Try again, matey.
tag_portable_export_unsaved: Not shipped out: yer latest Media Tags alter be not stashed yet. Inspect th' connection, then try again.
tag_portable_copy_failed: Arr, could not copy. Select th' text an' copy it yerself.
tag_portable_import_desc: Pick an shipped out file or paste its text. Th' ship server checks every settin' afore ye decide.
tag_portable_import_unsaved: Not checked: yer latest Media Tags alter be not stashed yet. Inspect th' connection, then try again.
tag_portable_import_changed: Yer settin's altered since th' peek. This be th' peek again: inspect it, then put to use.
tag_portable_no_changes: Nothin' would alter: these be already yer settin's.
tag_portable_skipped_desc: These be port as they be.
tag_portable_apply_failed: Arr, could not stash th' settin's. Nothin' was altered.
tag_portable_error_not_json: This be not a settin's document (it be not valid JSON).
tag_portable_error_not_object: This be not a settin's document.
tag_portable_error_kind: This be not a Media Tags settin's document fer sailors.
tag_portable_error_version: Th' document has no valid version number.
tag_portable_error_newer: This document comes from a newer version o' Jellyfin Enhanced. Update th' plugin to haul it in.
tag_portable_error_name: Give th' preset a name (up to 60 characters).
tag_portable_error_description: Th' description be longer than 240 characters.
tag_portable_error_empty: None o' these settin's can be used.
tag_portable_error_full: Ye already have {max} presets. Scuttle one first.
tag_portable_error_save: Something went wrong. Try again, matey.
tag_presets_desc: Ready-made looks. Applyin' one hoists what alterations first, an' ye can undo it.
tag_presets_none_yet: None yet. Stash yer current settin's as a preset, or haul in one someone shared.
tag_presets_load_failed: Arr, could not load th' presets.
tag_presets_share_desc: Copy this text an' send it; any hand can haul it in as a preset.
tag_presets_shared: {name} copied. Paste it to share it, matey.
tag_presets_delete_failed: Arr, could not scuttle {name}. Inspect th' connection, then try again.
tag_presets_save_desc: Keeps yer current Media Tags settin's under a name, on this ship server, fer every device ye sign in on.
tag_presets_save_unsaved: Not stashed as a preset: yer latest Media Tags alter be not stashed yet. Inspect th' connection, then try again.
tag_presets_full: Ye have {max} presets. Scuttle one to stash another.
tag_presets_import_desc: Pick a preset file or paste a shared preset. It be tacked on to yer presets; put to use it from th' list.
tag_presets_builtin_cinephile_desc: Quality, critics' scores an' awards up front, wi' reputations coloured by score.
tag_presets_builtin_minimal_desc: Just resolution an' one score in small, compact chips; everything else stays off.
tag_presets_builtin_kids_desc: Big, friendly tags: age ratin', tale type an' what's fresh, without scores or technical details.
admin_tags_portable_desc: Copy these ship server-wide Media Tags settin's to another ship server, or keep a backup. An haul in hoists what alterations an' be stashed like any mend on this page.
admin_tags_portable_secrets: API keys an' th' custom rule key be never shipped out or hauled in.
admin_tags_portable_export_title: Ship out ship server Media Tags settin's
admin_tags_portable_export_desc: Every settin' on this page: standards, crews, Tag Styles, custom rules, award lists, logo choices, status windows, chest options an' offered presets.
admin_tags_portable_export_unsaved: Not shipped out: alterations on this page be not stashed yet. Retry th' stash, or pick Keep mine or Take theirs, then ship out again.
admin_tags_portable_import_title: Haul in ship server Media Tags settin's
admin_tags_portable_import_desc: Pick a ship server ship out or paste its text. Settin's th' ship server does not accept be listed an' skipped.
admin_tags_portable_import_unsaved: Not previewed: alterations on this page be not stashed yet. Retry th' stash, or pick Keep mine or Take theirs, then peek again.
admin_tags_portable_import_changed: Settin's on this page altered since th' peek. This be th' peek again: inspect it, then put to use.
admin_tags_portable_apply_confirm: Alter {count} ship server settin's fer all hands?
admin_tags_portable_apply_confirm_one: Alter {count} ship server settin' fer all hands?
admin_tags_portable_apply_refused: Another cap'n altered some o' these settin's meanwhile: pick Keep mine or Take theirs at th' top o' th' page. Th' other settin's were stashed.
admin_tags_presets_desc: Offer these presets in every sailor's Presets list, next to th' built-in ones. Up to 20.
admin_tags_presets_import_desc: Pick a preset or settin's file, or paste one a sailor shared.
admin_tags_presets_name_desc: {count} settin's. Name th' preset as sailors will see it.
admin_tags_presets_name_desc_one: {count} settin'. Name th' preset as sailors will see it.
admin_tags_presets_full: {max} presets be offered already. Cast off one first.
admin_tags_presets_mine_unsaved: Not offered: yer latest alter to yer own Media Tags settin's be not stashed yet. Inspect th' connection, then try again.
admin_tags_presets_remove_confirm: Stop offerin' {name}? Sailors who put to use it keep their settin's.
admin_tags_tab_overview_desc: What fresh sailors get today an' th' state o' th' tag chest. Sailors can still alter their own look in their Media Tags settin's.
media_tags_docs_link_label: Learn more, matey about {name} in th' documentation (opens in a fresh tab)
admin_tags_tab_layout_desc: Th' layout, label density, crew order, berths an' limits fresh sailors start wi'.
admin_tags_tab_groups_desc: Turn each tag crew on or off fer fresh sailors, an' open a crew fer its ship server settin's.
admin_tags_tab_rules_desc: Give some cards a different look by library, type, tale type or age ratin'.
admin_tags_tab_colours_desc: Th' paints o' th' tags, on th' web an' in native posters.
admin_tags_tab_badges_desc: Which status badges fresh sailors start wi', an' how long a title counts as fresh.
admin_tags_tab_server_desc: Th' tag data th' ship server keeps, an' tags drawn into poster images fer other apps.
